description: The manufacturer's high-voltage battery warranty for a make, model and model year, as the Census EV warranty checker gives it: the term in years and miles (with the trims each term covers where the terms differ by trim), whether it is still in force at an odometer reading where that can be established, the battery capacity the warranty guarantees, and whether coverage transfers to a later owner. A term is marked estimated when it is not the manufacturer's own figure. Returns established: false and no term when the versions of that model year disagree or have not been researched. Includes the model's battery-warranty fact sheet on censusev.com where one exists.

make.description: Make, e.g. "Kia". Case, spacing and common short forms ("Chevy", "VW") are accepted.

mileage.description: Odometer reading in miles. With it, status says whether the warranty is in force where that can be established.

model.description: Model, e.g. "EV6". Punctuation and spacing are ignored.

name: battery_warranty
title: Battery warranty by model year
